UI_optionscreen_binding_MinidoracatBuild: Build cursor: eyedropper (hold, then click something)
UI_MinidoracatBuilder_ShowDock_tooltip: The Build Anything button on the family toolbar. When it is off, open the window with the key set in Key bindings > Minidoracat Build Anything.
UI_MinidoracatBuilder_ShowRoofs: Show roofs on your level while building
UI_MinidoracatBuilder_ShowRoofs_tooltip: While you hold a Build Anything cursor, eaves and porch roofs on your level stay solid instead of fading out. Only your own level: when you stand downstairs, the floors above are still hidden.
UI_MinidoracatBuilder_Opacity_tooltip: How solid the Build Anything window background is. Only the background fades.
UI_optionscreen_binding_MinidoracatBuild: Open or close the build window
